scope: TUI command dispatch and asynchronous handling with actual local process, checkpoints and saved evidence
assertions: Review does not execute command; incorrect and replayed confirmation cannot dispatch
Confirmed command executes exactly once and produces visible successful exit/stdout
Saved evidence is listed and a later workspace edit yields stale assessment
Unlisted deletion is refused; listed deletion removes record and does not undo external command effect
Invalid syntax and unavailable checkpoint configuration report errors without changing session identity or retaining worker
limits: In-process TUI journey, not built binary PTY rendering
Native macOS development run with local Harness dependency
Package-only coverage does not replace aggregate or critical-group profiles
Clean candidate, released Harness, platform and final acceptance gates remain open
